_meta.description: Second same-day live re-read of the five official listings, the five owner short links and the three Associates policy pages, performed 2026-11-20 by arena/3e4c3d2a-prod2 with the fetch tool. This file records OBSERVATIONS only. It never overwrites data/p2/products.json, data/p2/intent-links.json or data/p2/sources.json; where an observation changes or confirms a register row, the change is made in the register itself and this file is the evidence for it.
_meta.method: fetch_page on https://www.amazon.com/dp/{ASIN} for each of the five registered ASINs; fetch_page on each of the five owner-submitted https://link.amazon/ URLs with redirects followed; fetch_page on the three Associates policy pages. The sandbox's own curl cannot reach www.amazon.com or affiliate-program.amazon.com (http 000), so every read below came through the fetch tool, and every row names the tool that produced it.
_meta.prior_read_same_day: data/p2/live-check-2026-11-20-722181aa.json (session arena/722181aa-prod2). Two independent sessions, two independent reads, same day.
_meta.price_policy: F-02 stands: no price, rating or review count is published anywhere on the site and none is stored in this file. What is recorded is only WHETHER a price block attributable to the product's own page was present in the retrieved variant — that is the fact the owner's dated-snapshot question (SG-05 / Q-27) actually needs.
not_verified_here: Associates enrollment status of this account, tag attribution and commission income (F-57, F-58).
Whether the short-link redirect behaviour is an artefact of the fetch tool or of the short-link service (F-P24).
Any price value; the presence flag is recorded, the number is not.

short_links.difference_from_earlier_read: The 06:38 UTC read by session arena/722181aa-prod2 got an HTTP 500 for this code and no destination; this read resolved it to the Amazon homepage like the other four. The difference between '500' and 'homepage' for the same code inside one hour is itself the evidence that the behaviour is not a stable property of the link.

short_link_conclusion.finding: All five owner-submitted short links resolved to the Amazon.com homepage in this read, and four of five did so in the independent read by session arena/722181aa-prod2 twenty minutes earlier. F-P24 reproduces. The register's intended-ASIN fields are untouched: an observed redirect target is an observation, not an intent (intent-links.json keeps them in separate fields, F-67).
short_link_conclusion.cause: not determinable from outside the account — a fetch-tool artefact (bot handling of link.amazon) and a short-link service change are both consistent with the evidence. A browser check by the owner is the test that settles it.
short_link_conclusion.reader_facing_impact: none. The site never publishes a short link as a buy path; tools/build.py renders any link.amazon anchor as inert quoted text and the release gate fails the build if a clickable one returns.
